error_message: PC HTTPS remote had no non-interactive credential; SSH also denied
fix: Use GitHub connector for canonical remote synchronization; do not alter research methodology.
lesson: Separate heavy-PC execution from authenticated remote synchronization.
root_cause: Local PC cannot authenticate to GitHub remote; GitHub connector remains authoritative for remote reads/writes.
verification: PR #5 and remote CI metadata retrieved through GitHub connector.

error_message: pip installed into V7 because V8 pip shebang/editable pointer referenced the V7 worktree
failing_test: pyarrow import from V8 interpreter failed immediately after pip reported success
fix: Use .venv/bin/python -m pip and reinstall editable project from the V8 worktree.
lesson: Never trust copied venv entrypoint shebangs across worktrees.
next_allowed_direction: always bind installs to explicit V8 interpreter
root_cause: The V8 copied virtual environment retained absolute V7 worktree paths.
verification: crypto_research import resolves to V8 path; pyarrow 25.0.1 imports; targeted tests execute against V8 source.

error_message: Local V8 mirror is based on stale commit and misses 41 remote V7 files.
failing_test: local full-suite missing-artifact failure vs remote PR #5 CI 174-pass baseline
fix: Treat GitHub PR head as canonical, run targeted PC tests for new logic, then atomically sync exact changed files and rely on remote full CI.
lesson: A small diff on a stale worktree is not a valid source-of-truth.
next_allowed_direction: atomic GitHub sync followed by authoritative CI
root_cause: PC worktree was not a clean mirror of the current PR head.
verification: Remote baseline CI #398 green; local new-feature targeted suites green.

fix: Stamp first_seen_at after each HTTP response; stop injecting one batch-start timestamp into all endpoint calls; bump schema to v8-positioning-2.
lesson: Availability must be response-receipt time or later, never request/batch-start time for serial external calls.
next_allowed_direction: collect fresh v8-positioning-2 forward coverage; do not use v1 rows as causal features
root_cause: fetch_positioning_snapshot captured first_seen_at before serial HTTP calls, so premium-index exchange timestamps could advance beyond the declared availability time.
verification: first v2 restart cycle: 126 rows, 21 symbols, 6 families, 0 event_after_available violations; regression test passes.
